title: CLCON/492/2018 of Bharat Joshi Vs Tara Chandra Pant

paras.text:
CLCON No. 492 of 2018
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. G.D. Joshi, Advocate for the
applicant.
Mr. J.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holder for
the respondent.
Compliance affidavit has been filed on
behalf of the respondent stating therein that
representation of the applicant has been
decided on 28.07.2018 in terms of the order
dated 11.06.2018 passed by co-ordinate Bench
of this Court in WPSS No. 619 of 2018.
Sri G.D. Joshi, learned counsel for the
applicant, however, submits that proper
compliance has not been made.
Be that as it may, the fact remains that
the decision has been taken by the respondent
on the representation of the applicant. If at all,
applicant is aggrieved by the order passed on
his representation, he is at liberty to challenge
the same by availing appropriate remedy.
Accordingly, the contempt petition is
closed. Notice issued to the respondent is
hereby discharged.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
15.11.2018
Aswal
